component.name: OpenWitty
component.summary: Experimental Linux control application for the LEWITT CONNECT 2

description.p: OpenWitty is an independent, open-source Linux control application for LEWITT CONNECT audio interfaces (initially the CONNECT 2). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by LEWITT.

Status: experimental alpha, tested with one CONNECT 2 on one Linux system. It shows the live device state read-only and can keep the desktop volume in step with the speaker volume knob, also through an optional background user service. Most other controls work with the included simulated device only. Device-changing options are off by default and need confirmation. Firmware update and factory reset are not implemented, the CONNECT 6 is not supported, and it is not a replacement for LEWITT CONTROL CENTER.
Access to the real device needs a USB permission rule installed by an administrator (included in distribution packages).
First alpha (prepared, not yet published): live read-only view of one CONNECT 2, desktop volume integration with an optional background service and system tray icon, simulated device.
